The repeated room framing is restrained but modest; the top fade slightly washes the small UT announcement source strip on s7 while its consent headline remains clear.
axis_notes.voice: Plain, carefully qualified script and measured caption edges are supported. No direct vocal-performance or final-mix listening conclusion is claimed.
